tools.building_control.description: Unified building entrypoint. Locate targets with action plus query, target, search, id, plan, or areaId. Exact construction uses world_editor SEARCH/REPLACE edits of /active/map/viewport.md; direct build_area and hidden coordinate_control calls are not public routes. Readonly geometry: inspect existing completed buildings by id/query/prefabId, or definition by exact prefabId. Use compact=true/false.
tools.building_control.parameters.domain: Building subsystem: planning, config, production, storage, filter, tile_selection, receptacle, side_surface, space_building, space_story, special, story_facility, or rocket. geometry.
tools.building_control.parameters.action: Building action. Planning examples: search_defs/materials/preview/placement_candidates. Exact construction is virtual-file only: edit /active/map/viewport.md with world_editor. Public build_area coordinate or anchor calls are forbidden. Readonly geometry: inspect existing completed buildings by id/query/prefabId, or definition by exact prefabId. Use compact=true/false.

tools.building_control.parameters.kind: Optional subtype used by some domains.

tools.building_control.parameters.catego: Recipe category ID for production list_recipes.

tools.building_control.parameters.items: Batch queue items for production batch.

tools.building_control.parameters.resour: Resource, storage filter tag, or building name filter.
tools.building_control.parameters.clear: Clear the current selection where supported.
tools.building_control.parameters.replac: Replace an existing request where supported.
tools.building_control.parameters.limit: Maximum number of items to return or process.
tools.building_control.parameters.itemId: Target prefab, tag, or ID for side_surface/facility/printing_pod claim and item selection actions.
tools.building_control.parameters.reward: Reward index for side_surface surface=facility kind=printing_pod action=claim.
tools.building_control.parameters.confir: Required confirmation for write, dangerous, or batch actions.
tools.building_control.parameters.dryRun: For actions that support preview, inspect planned changes without applying them. Check the selected action's contract; not every action supports dryRun.
tools.building_control.parameters.autoLa: For planning room_template, automatically choose a layout candidate when area/x/query is absent.
tools.building_control.parameters.topPri: For supported planning/order actions, request red-alert highest priority.
tools.building_control.parameters.execut: For planning room_template, immediately execute the generated calls.

tools.building_control.parameters.dir: Alias of direction for planning repair_line.
tools.building_control.parameters.steps: For planning repair_line, cells to connect in direction, default 1.
tools.game_control.description: Unified game entrypoint for speed, pause/resume, game state, saves, DLC activation, sandbox operations, and UI actions. Use domain=ui uiDomain=dialog to inspect or acknowledge the current MOD mismatch dialog. Use semantic actions and named targets; coordinate input is not accepted here. uiDomain=selection supports passive status and explicit select/close/scroll_up/scroll_down for one duplicant by exact id.
tools.game_control.parameters.domain: Game subsystem: launch, speed, state, save, dlc, sandbox, or ui.
tools.game_control.parameters.action: Game action for the selected subsystem. domain=speed supports time, pause, resume, set_speed and read-only trace. UI feedback supports notification, popup, speech_bubble and marker; uiDomain=dialog supports status and acknowledge for the current MOD mismatch dialog. domain=save supports list, status, save, load and quit; status only reads cached MOD labels and never loads a save. uiDomain=selection supports passive status and explicit select/close/scroll_up/scroll_down for one duplicant by exact id. Selection UI mutations require task and confirm=true; dryRun invokes no UI. Scroll requires the selected duplicant UI; scroll_up/down dispatches one native wheel event (+1/-1) and returns pending, without guaranteeing distance, completion or visibility. Request a later status or screenshot explicitly.
tools.game_control.parameters.uiDomain: UI subsystem: action, feedback, dialog or selection.
tools.game_control.parameters.enabled: Write operations for domain=state: true=enabled, false=disabled.
tools.game_control.parameters.allWorlds: For domain=state, apply to or read all loaded worlds. Defaults to false.
tools.game_control.parameters.type: Search scope for domain=save list/load index: local, cloud, or both. Defaults to both.
tools.game_control.parameters.limit: Maximum returned rows for reads. save/status defaults to 20, maximum 100.
tools.game_control.parameters.name: Save name, or duplicant name for ui/feedback speech_bubble.
tools.game_control.parameters.updateActi: After a successful domain=save action=save, set this as the current active save. Defaults to true.
tools.game_control.parameters.index: The index returned by game_control domain=save action=list, used by domain=save action=load.
tools.game_control.parameters.forceLoad: Launch domain: force loading target save even when already in game.
tools.game_control.parameters.resume: Launch domain: unpause after loading or when already in game.
tools.game_control.parameters.jobId: Optional job ID for domain=launch action=restart_status.
tools.game_control.parameters.target: Target for save quit actions, or semantic target for other actions.
tools.game_control.parameters.saveFirst: For domain=save action=quit, save before quitting. Defaults to false.
tools.game_control.parameters.includeCos: For domain=dlc action=list, include cosmetic/content-only DLC. Defaults to false.
tools.game_control.parameters.dlcId: DLC ID for domain=dlc action=activate. Examples: DLC2_ID, DLC3_ID, DLC4_ID, DLC5_ID.
tools.game_control.parameters.uiAction: Action enum name for domain=ui uiDomain=action action=trigger.
tools.game_control.parameters.screen: Screen name for domain=ui uiDomain=action action=open_management.
tools.game_control.parameters.title: Notification title for domain=ui uiDomain=feedback action=notification.
tools.game_control.parameters.message: Notification body or guidance text for domain=ui; interpreted according to action.
tools.game_control.parameters.text: Displayed text for ui/feedback popup or speech_bubble; required for speech_bubble.
tools.game_control.parameters.duration: Speech-bubble display duration in seconds; defaults to 5 and is clamped to 0.5-30.
tools.game_control.parameters.markerActi: Sub-action for domain=ui uiDomain=feedback action=marker: create/list/clear.
tools.game_control.parameters.element: Element id used by sandbox painting actions.
tools.game_control.parameters.prefabId: Prefab id used by sandbox entity spawn actions.
tools.game_control.parameters.id: Target object id, or duplicant instance id for ui/feedback speech_bubble. uiDomain=selection requires the exact nonzero canonical Int32 duplicant id for status/select/close/scroll_up/scroll_down; alternate selectors are rejected.
tools.game_control.parameters.query: save/status: filter saved label id/title before limit. sandbox/read/list_story_traits: search text.
tools.game_control.parameters.temperatur: Temperature in K for domain=sandbox; interpreted according to action.
tools.game_control.parameters.disease: Disease ID for domain=sandbox. Defaults to none.
tools.game_control.parameters.diseaseCou: Disease count per cell for domain=sandbox. Defaults to 0.
tools.game_control.parameters.maxCells: Safety limit for domain=sandbox area/search operations.
tools.game_control.parameters.dryRun: For supported actions, preview without applying changes. uiDomain=dialog action=acknowledge validates the current target without invoking its button when true. Other actions retain their own preview contract. selection select/close/scroll_up/scroll_down validates existing UI targets without native selection, close, wheel events or UI refresh.
tools.game_control.parameters.visibleOnl: Treat unrevealed cells as unknown while searching.
tools.game_control.parameters.force: Allow lower-level force behavior where supported.
tools.game_control.parameters.confirm: Required confirmation for write, dangerous, or batch actions.
tools.navigation_control.description: Unified camera and view entrypoint for camera movement, world switching, overlays, focus, and screenshots. Y+ (increasing Y) is up (toward the surface); Y- (decreasing Y) is down (toward the underground). Screenshot capture returns a requestId; use screenshot_status for completion and actual frame metadata.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.doma: Camera domain. If omitted, the tool accepts known camera actions.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.acti: Camera action: get_view, set_active_world, set_view, move, switch_view, focus_cell, focus_dupe, screenshot, coordinate_screenshot, or screenshot_status.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.worl: Target world id; required by set_active_world and otherwise defaults to the active world.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.requ: Require the target world to be discovered before switching.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.look: Reveal the target world's surface before switching when needed.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.snap: Snap immediately instead of moving smoothly.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.mode: Camera move mode: pan or jump.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.wait: Render frames to wait before capture: 1 to 30, default 2 (coordinate_screenshot: 3). This is not a completion guarantee; poll screenshot_status by requestId.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.name: Duplicant name for focus_dupe.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.focu: Move the camera to frame a coordinate screenshot area.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.padd: Padding around a coordinate screenshot area.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.show: Show coordinates around the screenshot edge.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.incl: Show sparse coordinate labels inside the screenshot.
tools.orders_control.description: Unified orders entrypoint. Use action plus query, target, search, id, or areaId for locating targets. Coordinate input is not accepted here; route exact coordinate operations through coordinate_control.
tools.orders_control.parameters.domain: Order domain: priority, area, or designation. If omitted, inferred from action.
tools.orders_control.parameters.action: Order action for the selected domain.
tools.orders_control.parameters.type: Conduit or cut type used by conduit actions.
tools.orders_control.parameters.mode: Mode for attack or capture actions.
tools.orders_control.parameters.dryRun: For actions that support preview, inspect planned changes without applying them. Check the selected action's contract; not every action supports dryRun.
tools.orders_control.parameters.force: Allow lower-level force behavior where supported.
tools.orders_control.parameters.attackAr: Required literal confirmation for area attack marking.
tools.orders_control.parameters.minimumM: Minimum mass per delivery in kilograms.
tools.orders_control.parameters.limit: Maximum number of items to return or process.
tools.orders_control.parameters.confirm: Required confirmation for write, dangerous, or batch actions.

tools.server_control.parameters.domain: Server subsystem: diagnostics, client_request, catalog, batch, or program. Defaults to diagnostics.
tools.server_control.parameters.action: Server action for the selected domain.
tools.server_control.parameters.file: Log file selector: current or previous.
tools.server_control.parameters.lines: Number of log lines to return.
tools.server_control.parameters.goal: Player goal or intended action for catalog guide.
tools.server_control.parameters.limit: Maximum number of items to return or process.
tools.server_control.parameters.defaults: Default arguments merged into each batch call.
tools.server_control.parameters.stopOnEr: Stop a batch after the first error.
tools.server_control.parameters.dryRun: For actions that support preview, inspect planned changes without applying them. Check the selected action's contract; not every action supports dryRun.
tools.server_control.parameters.requireA: domain=batch action=call_many: require all child calls to pass preflight validation before execution. Defaults to true.
tools.server_control.parameters.response: domain=batch action=call_many: full/summary/errors. Defaults to summary.

tools.server_control.parameters.level: middleware queue: notification level. Defaults to info.
tools.server_control.parameters.required: Whether the elicitation field is required.
tools.world_editor.description: Code-file style ONI world editor. Use read/grep/symbols/search/edit for virtual files; use game/camera/view/batch to combine pause, view control, and world reads in one call. Y+ (increasing Y) is up (toward the surface); Y- (decreasing Y) is down (toward the underground).
tools.world_editor.parameters.command: cd, pwd, ls, read, zoom, grep, symbols, search, edit, blueprint, game, sandbox, pause, resume, speed, camera, view, screenshot, batch.
tools.world_editor.parameters.content: For edit: SEARCH/REPLACE block against current virtual file.
tools.world_editor.parameters.orientatio: Forwarded build orientation for map edits, e.g. Neutral, R90, R180, R270.
tools.world_editor.parameters.rotation: Alias for build orientation in map edits; accepts 0/90/180/270, right/left, clockwise/counterclockwise.
tools.world_editor.parameters.query: Search query or natural-language edit target.
tools.world_editor.parameters.queries: symbols: batch glyph codes or names, at most 100 strings.
tools.world_editor.parameters.perQueryLi: symbols: matches per query, default 20, maximum 100.
tools.world_editor.parameters.name: Blueprint command file/name for list/read/create/delete/use.
tools.world_editor.parameters.action: Forwarded game/camera action or command alias.
tools.world_editor.parameters.tool: Batch step tool: world_editor, game_control, navigation_control.
tools.world_editor.parameters.steps: Batch steps. Each step is a world_editor/game_control/navigation_control argument object.
tools.world_editor.parameters.view: Overlay context for symbols/read/zoom, e.g. power, oxygen, temperature.
tools.world_editor.parameters.compact: Map read/zoom compression. Default true uses per-5-cell RLE like 粉x3; false expands every cell for editing. Readonly geometry: inspect existing completed buildings by id/query/prefabId, or definition by exact prefabId. Use compact=true/false.

tools.benchmark.description: Tool pipeline benchmark entrypoint. Runs defined test cases and returns results in a shared format (ok/failed/tests/summary/duration). Does not change game state.
tools.benchmark.parameters.cases: Comma-separated list of test cases to run. Supports all, toolList, toolLookup, jsonSerialize. Defaults to all.
tools.benchmark.parameters.iterations: Iterations per test case (1-5000). Defaults to 200.
tools.benchmark.parameters.tool: Target tool name for toolLookup (for example, server_control). Defaults to world_editor when blank.
tools.benchmark.parameters.includeDetail: Whether to return detailed fields for each test. Defaults to false.
tools.task.description: Required for every tool call: briefly describe what you are doing so it can be shown near the player's mouse in-game.
tools.building_control.parameters.compac: Geometry read profile: true (default) returns compact bounds and ports; false includes all occupied cells, definition offsets and source evidence.
tools.building_control.parameters.capabi: config list capability filter, including threshold, direction and activation_range. Read configurationReads for the actual setting route.
tools.world_editor.parameters.allowUtili: Explicitly permit natural terrain digging for utility placement and automatic power routes. Default false; confirm alone does not permit it. Supports are not evaluated.
tools.world_editor.parameters.autoConnec: Automatically wire powered buildings; default true. Natural terrain routes require allowUtilityTerrainDig=true. Set false to build without automatic wiring.
tools.game_control.parameters.afterSeque: For action=trace, return records after this nonnegative integer sequence. Requires the traceEpoch from a prior trace response.
tools.game_control.parameters.traceEpoch: Opaque trace-process epoch returned by action=trace. Required with afterSequence; a different process epoch is rejected.
tools.navigation_control.parameters.requ: Screenshot request ID returned by capture acceptance; required for screenshot_status.
